account (table)
- account_id: INTEGER NOT NULL
- district_id: INTEGER NOT NULL
- frequency: TEXT NOT NULL
- date: DATE NOT NULL
PRIMARY KEY (account_id)
FOREIGN KEY (district_id) REFERENCES district (district_id)

district (table)
- district_id: INTEGER NOT NULL
- A2: TEXT NOT NULL
- A3: TEXT NOT NULL
- A4: TEXT NOT NULL
- A5: TEXT NOT NULL
- A6: TEXT NOT NULL
- A7: TEXT NOT NULL

- A9: INTEGER NOT NULL
- A10: REAL NOT NULL
- A11: INTEGER NOT NULL
- A12: REAL
- A13: REAL NOT NULL
- A14: INTEGER NOT NULL
- A15: INTEGER
- A16: INTEGER NOT NULL
PRIMARY KEY (district_id)

disp (table)
- disp_id: INTEGER NOT NULL
- client_id: INTEGER NOT NULL
- account_id: INTEGER NOT NULL
- type: TEXT NOT NULL
PRIMARY KEY (disp_id)
FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES account (account_id)
FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES client (client_id)

arguments.sql:
SELECT disp.type, COUNT(DISTINCT disp.account_id) AS account_count
FROM disp
JOIN account ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN district ON district.district_id = account.district_id
WHERE disp.type <> 'OWNER'
  AND district.A11 > 8000
  AND district.A11 <= 9000
GROUP BY disp.type;

SELECT disp.type, COUNT(DISTINCT disp.account_id) AS account_count
FROM disp
JOIN account ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN district ON district.district_id = account.district_id
WHERE disp.type <> 'OWNER'
  AND district.A11 > 8000
  AND district.A11 <= 9000
GROUP BY disp.type;
